user.title: Connect eBlocker
user.description: Enter the address of your eBlocker. The admin password is only needed if one is set in the eBlocker settings.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the eBlocker, e.g. 192.168.1.10.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the eBlocker REST API (default 3000).
data_description.password: Password of the eBlocker admin console.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: The eBlocker knows {count} network devices. Select the devices that should get their own entities (protection status, pause, filter switches). You can change this later in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate eBlocker
reauth_confirm.description: The admin password for the eBlocker at {host} was rejected. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure eBlocker
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the eBlocker. Check host and port.
error.invalid_auth: The admin password is wrong or missing.
error.login_throttled: The eBlocker temporarily blocks password entry after a failed attempt. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different eBlocker.

data_description.pause_minutes: Used when a pause switch is turned on. The pause action allows any duration.

pause_not_allowed.message: The eBlocker does not allow pausing {device}. Pausing is not possible for devices whose user profile has parental control restrictions.

pause_device_disabled.message: {device} is not protected by the eBlocker, so it cannot be paused.

not_a_filter_list.message: This action only works for eBlocker filter list switches.

not_a_pause_switch.message: This action only works for eBlocker pause switches.

filter_list_not_found.message: The filter list {name} no longer exists on the eBlocker.

filter_list_builtin.message: {name} is a built-in filter list. It can only be turned on or off, not changed or removed.

filter_list_without_url.message: {name} consists of manually entered domains. eBlockerOS cannot change such lists via its API; remove it and add it again instead.

url_or_domains.message: Specify either a URL or a list of domains (exactly one of them).

config_entry_required.message: Several eBlockers are configured. Select one with config_entry_id.

updates_disabled.message: Updates are disabled on this eBlocker.

update_not_started.message: The eBlocker did not start the update. Another update, download or check may still be running.

check_too_frequent.message: The eBlocker allows checking for updates only once per minute.

user_not_found.message: The user {user} does not exist on the eBlocker.

not_a_profile_device.message: Select a parental control profile device of the eBlocker integration.

not_a_user_profile.message: Only users can be deleted, not the standard profile.

time_window_invalid.message: The end of an online time window must be after its start.

vpn_profile_not_found.message: The VPN profile {profile} does not exist on the eBlocker.

anonymization_device_disabled.message: {device} is not protected by the eBlocker, so its traffic cannot be anonymized.

pause.name: Pause protection
pause.description: Pauses eBlocker protection for the selected devices. A duration of 0 ends a running pause.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the protection is paused (max. 24 hours).

add_filter_list.name: Add filter list
add_filter_list.description: Adds a custom filter list to the eBlocker, either from a URL (downloaded regularly) or from a list of domains.

config_entry_id.name: eBlocker
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several eBlockers are configured.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of the list. Either a URL or domains.

domains.name: Domains
domains.description: Domains to block (or allow). Either domains or a URL.

format.name: Format
format.description: Format of the list. Domain formats create a DNS list, EasyList/URLs create a pattern list.

update_interval.name: Update interval
update_interval.description: How often a URL list is downloaded again (default: daily).

update_filter_list.name: Change filter list
update_filter_list.description: Changes name, description, URL or update interval of a custom filter list. A new URL triggers a new download.

update_interval.name: Update interval
update_interval.description: How often the list is downloaded again.

remove_filter_list.name: Remove filter list
remove_filter_list.description: Removes a custom filter list from the eBlocker. Built-in lists cannot be removed.

add_bonus_time.name: Add bonus time
add_bonus_time.description: Gives additional online time for today (negative values take it away again).

set_usage_limit.name: Set daily time limit
set_usage_limit.description: Sets the maximum online time per day.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days the limit applies to (default: all).

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Also turn the daily time limit on.

set_online_times.name: Set online times
set_online_times.description: Replaces the time windows in which internet access is allowed.

times.name: Time windows
times.description: List of windows with day (monday..sunday, weekdays, weekend), start and end (HH:MM). An empty list removes all windows.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Also turn online times on (off for an empty list).

set_blocked_lists.name: Set blocked categories
set_blocked_lists.description: Sets which parental control lists (e.g. gambling, social networks) are blocked for the profile.

filter_lists.name: Filter lists
filter_lists.description: Names (German or English) or IDs of the lists to block. Replaces the current selection.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Also turn the web filter on.

create_user.name: Create user
create_user.description: Creates a user with an own parental control profile. Children get the settings template the eBlocker suggests for their age.

config_entry_id.name: eBlocker
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several eBlockers are configured.

birthday.name: Birthday
birthday.description: Used to pick the age-based template for children.

delete_user.name: Delete user
delete_user.description: Deletes a user and the user's profile. Assigned devices go back to the standard profile.
